page 28 · listen and read

Mr Gray & Mrs Day 🏡🚜

🏡🥬🧅 🍐🚌 🏠🚜 🐄🐑🐐🦆🐔🐕
Mr Gray is a farmer. There are cows, sheep, goats, ducks and chickens on his farm. There's a dog too!
Mrs Day lives next to Mr Gray's farm. There are potatoes, onions, beans, peas and two pear trees in her garden.
Mr Gray is going to the town now. He's going in his truck. Mrs Day is going to the shops. She's going on the bus.
page 29 · listen and read

Oh dear! 😱 The gates are open!

🚪❌🔒 🐄🐑🐐 🏃💨 🦆🐔🏡
Oh dear!
Mr Gray's farm gate is open.
Oh dear!
Mrs Day's garden gate is open too!
Look at the cows and sheep! Look at the goats and ducks and chickens!
They're running and jumping in Mrs Day's garden!
page 30 · listen and read

They're wearing her clothes! 👒👗

🐑🧥 🐄👒 🐐👗 🦆👕 🫘🍐🥔🧅
They're eating her potatoes and her onions and peas.
They're eating her beans and the pears in her trees.
They're wearing her hats and her T-shirts and shirts.
They're wearing her dresses and sweaters and skirts!
page 31 · listen and read

Here's Mrs Day! 😠

👩‍🦰🛍️👨‍🌾🛍️ 🚌🚚 🏡
But look! Here's Mrs Day.
She's coming home from the shops. Mr Gray's coming home too.
«I'm very angry!» says Mrs Day. «Look at my clothes and look at my trees!»
«I'm very sorry!» says Mr Gray.
